chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: First hearing Tatum in a New York basement
summary: Before he played guitar he heard Tatum outplay a roomful of pianists, which led him to look for another instrument.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: When did you first hear Tatum?

I heard him hear when I was playing piano & just starting on the guitar. And he used to come to a little spot in the basement. And James P. Johnson, Tremble & Chisholm some guy named Chisholm... and they all used to melt up there for a cutting session, they called it. And I used to go up there listening, and I called myself a piano player. But I had never met him, I never said anything to him, or nothin'. I just sat around listening.

And these cats when I got thru playing I'd say "what the hell am I doin' even looking at a piano?" But at that time I had been looking for something else to start with. That's where the guitar came in. So I had heard him first, but I didn't know him. He was with playing with this Adelaide something... Adelaide Hall I think I believe. Whoever it was, that introduced him into New York. And everybody was on his tail. All the piano players was on his case. You know, when they find a new cat come town, that can play, you know they watch for him. And they gathered him all up. But you see what he did, he let 'em all play, he wouldn't touch the piano until everybody played. And there must have been about ten of 'em, and they played, and they played. I mean they played. This cat would come & sit down & wash them all -- made you forget the other ten. ha ha! He made them forget themselves. He was something else, man. I don't know how that cat did it. And have himself a bottle of beer, Pabst Blue Ribbon Beer. Quart of a bottle of beer in one hand and playing with the other & you'd think there were three people up there. That's how I first heard him. Then the next time -- way years later -- that I found myself playing with the same cat I couldn't believe it. Jammin' with him anyhow. That's why I tried so hard. I tried awful hard! ... I gave it my best shot.
